briefing.text: Do not limit BCL2 to nonsynonymous calls. The MAF holds many BCL2 Silent, Missense and 5'UTR/5'Flank calls (library counts: about 34 Silent, 29 Missense, about 60 UTR/Flank), with several hits in some samples (up to about 8-9 in one). Tabulate BCL2 Variant_Classification and count BCL2 variants of every class per sample. Clustered multi-hit BCL2 mutation near the TSS is the pattern of AID-driven aberrant somatic hypermutation, which in BCL2 typically affects the allele that t(14;18) places next to the IGH enhancers. Samples with many hits can therefore serve as a proxy for rearrangement.

briefing.text: Established biology, recalled without web verification (confidence medium): in follicular lymphoma and GCB-DLBCL, BCL2 point mutations are strongly enriched in t(14;18)/BCL2-IGH-positive cases. DLBCL genetic-subtype studies (Schmitz 2018 NEJM; Chapuy 2018 Nat Med; EZB/C3 cluster; also Schuetz 2012 Leukemia, Morin 2013 Blood) place BCL2 mutations in the same cluster as BCL2 structural variants and do not treat them as mutually exclusive alternatives. A minority of BCL2-mutated cases have no detectable translocation. A supporting proxy check: whether BCL2-mutated samples also carry other EZB/GCB markers (EZH2, KMT2D, CREBBP, TNFRSF14).
